hero.headline: Built by SOT.
hero.body: Audoryn is an SOT product. It brings AI workers into practical workflows while keeping authority, review and responsibility visible to people.

about.headline: A practice of turning ideas into working software.
paragraphs: SOT is the product brand founded by Divine Ogadinma Destiny in Nigeria. Its public portfolio spans web products, data analytics and intelligent automation.
Audoryn extends that work into autonomous software: a place to define what AI workers can do, supervise what they are doing and keep consequential decisions accountable.

portfolio.headline: More than one product.
portfolio.body: Three projects from SOT's public site show the range of work behind the brand.

items.title: SOT Browser

why.headline: When software can act,
paragraphs: Audoryn is SOT's answer to a practical product question: give AI workers clear responsibilities and useful tools, then make their boundaries, approvals and activity understandable to the people operating them.

founder.headline: Building across software, data and automation.
founder.name: Divine Ogadinma Destiny
paragraphs: Full-stack developer and technology entrepreneur. SOT's public portfolio documents the products and projects behind that work.
